description_zh: 先完成候選引子設計，再評估 Tm、GC%、hairpin、自身或異源二聚體及可能的非專一性擴增。
description_en: Design primer candidates and evaluate Tm, GC%, hairpins, homo-/heterodimers, and possible off-target amplification.

description_zh: 針對 F3／B3、FIP／BIP 及 LF／LB 等多引子組合設計；不同平台演算法不相同，需以實驗比較候選組。
description_en: Design multiple coordinated LAMP primers (F3/B3, FIP/BIP, LF/LB). Compare candidate sets experimentally because algorithms differ.

description_zh: RPA／RAA 引子與探針候選設計、文獻已驗證序列檢索；須自行確認所選試劑系統的設計規範。
description_en: Design RPA/RAA primer/probe candidates or consult literature-validated pairs. Follow your specific reagent platform's requirements.

description_zh: 設計含 T7 promoter 的 NASBA／TMA 引子，參考實作指南及具 NASBA 設定的桌面程式；目前沒有將這類指南誤標成完整線上設計器。
description_en: Learn promoter-tailed NASBA/TMA primer design from method guides and desktop software. Guidance is not presented as a fully automatic web designer.

description_zh: 查找 padlock probe 辨識臂、連接位點、條碼與多重設計流程；這類工具設計的是探針，不等於直接最佳化整套 RCA 酵素反應。
description_en: Select padlock probe arms, ligation sites, barcodes and multiplex panels. Probe design alone does not optimize the full RCA chemistry.

description_zh: 以原廠指南為主，說明 HDA 雙引子與 SDA／NEAR 的 nicking-site 引子尾端；沒有已確認可靠的專用網頁設計器。
description_en: Manufacturer guidelines for HDA primer pairs and SDA/NEAR nicking-site tails; dedicated validated web designers are not established.

name_zh: 核酸二級結構與 DNA Circuit
description_zh: 評估 RNA／DNA hairpin、交互作用、雙分子配對與多股系統，適合 HCR、toehold 及 DNA strand displacement 概念設計。
description_en: Analyze RNA/DNA hairpins, intermolecular interactions, bimolecular folding and multistrand systems for HCR, toehold and strand-displacement designs.
